messages:
Alice T.: Morning — quick pipeline check for Cornerstone. What I did: demo with their infra lead yesterday, shared SOW draft. Blockers: legal asked for KMS/HSM diagrams, need eng input for keywrap flow. Today: follow up with legal, ping eng for diagrams. @Carla M. can you confirm HSM timing?

Carla M.: Hey — HSM timeline is ~2 weeks for on-prem validation, but we can provide architecture docs + KMS integration notes today. I'll drop the diagrams.

Ben R.: Added the SOW change we discussed. Also raised the security question to sec-bot earlier.

sec-bot: Security request logged: ticket #SEC-4127 — requested artifacts: `kms-key-wrap.md`, `hsm-network-diagram.pdf`, audit-log-retention.csv. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

Alice T.: Thanks. For legal we need a short blurb describing who holds keys and where logs live. @Dave S. can you craft 2-3 lines?

Dave S.: Yep — draft coming in 30m.

Eve L.: Heads up — Cornerstone procurement asked about dedicated capacity SLAs. We should confirm Dedicated pricing/lead times. @Ben R. can you add to the proposal?

Ben R.: On it. Will append a pricing table and note lead times.

Carla M.: Uploaded initial HSM network diagram to the thread: https://redwood.internal/files/diagram-hsm-cornerstone-v1.pdf

Alice T.: Nice. Legal asked specifically about whether customer can rotate keys — answer: yes, via KMS integration; rotation process requires downtime window if using on-prem HSM. Dave, include that.

Dave S.: Included, plus a one-liner about audit logs retention and export. Pasting draft:

``
Customer-managed keys: Cornerstone will manage root keys in their HSM/KMS. Key rotation is supported; for on-prem HSM rotations a maintenance window (approx. 10-30 mins) is recommended. Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default and can be exported to customer's SIEM.
``

Alice T.: Perfect. Blocker: Need final confirmation on legal wording. I will set a 2pm sync with legal.

Ben R.: I'll prep the pricing appendix before that.

Carla M.: I'll validate HSM diagram with infra team and update if needed.

sec-bot: Reminder: attach `kms-key-wrap.md` to ticket #SEC-4127 when ready.

Eve L.: Nothing else from pipeline side. Closing today's standup. :thumbsup:
